name: useEmbeddings
summary: On-device text embeddings from a user-supplied TFLite model (MediaPipe TextEmbedder) and cosine similarity scoring.
plain: Converts text strings into dense float vectors locally for offline semantic search, deduplication, and RAG memory without server calls. Needs an embedder model file you place in the app's files directory; nothing is bundled or downloaded.
description: Runs the MediaPipe Tasks TextEmbedder (TFLite) on the device CPU (XNNPACK; no TPU/NPU delegate is configured). The model is read from filesDir/models/text_embedder.tflite and must be a .tflite embedder with TFLite metadata. Vectors are L2-normalised floats whose length is the model's real output size, reported through vectorDimension. When the file is missing or fails to load the hook reports isAvailable false, source 'unavailable' and the native reason in unavailableReason; embed() rejects instead of returning an empty vector. Includes an in-memory cosine similarity helper.

returns.name: isAvailable
returns.desc: True only when the model file exists, loaded, and produced a vector for a probe input.

returns.name: isLoading
returns.desc: Whether an embedding inference is currently running.

returns.name: vectorDimension
returns.desc: Real output length of the model's embedding vector; null until the native side or an embed() call has reported it.

returns.name: unavailableReason
returns.desc: Why the embedder is unavailable (missing model file, load failure); null when available.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if embedding inference failed.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: 'hardware' when the model is available and the last embed() did not fail; otherwise 'unavailable'.

returns.name: embed
returns.desc: Computes an L2-normalised float vector for the text. Rejects if the model is unavailable, the text is empty, or the model returns no vector.

returns.name: cosineSimilarity
returns.desc: Computes cosine similarity between two float vectors (-1.0 to 1.0); returns 0 for empty or different-length vectors.

actions.name: embed(text)
actions.desc: Generates an embedding vector from input text; rejects rather than returning an empty vector.

actions.name: cosineSimilarity(vecA, vecB)
actions.desc: Scores cosine similarity between two embedding vectors.

agentNote: Exported from '@pixelkit-labs/sdk/mlkit'. Android only. Requires a text embedder .tflite with TFLite metadata at <app filesDir>/models/text_embedder.tflite (the library neither bundles nor downloads it). Inference runs on CPU via MediaPipe TextEmbedder (XNNPACK), not on the Tensor TPU. Check isAvailable/unavailableReason before calling embed(); embed() rejects on failure, never returns []. vectorDimension is null until a real vector length is known. Vectors from different models are not comparable.
